key.name: accent-color
key.description: Hex colour used for focus highlighting and bloom.

key.name: theme
key.description: Which of salon/core/tokens.py's palettes paints the surfaces and text: midnight (the design default), graphite (hueless), ember (warm) or contrast (true black, for OLED and for a lit room). The accent colour is a separate choice and every palette works with any of them.

key.name: wallpaper-path
key.summary: Background image, or a folder of them
key.description: Drawn behind everything, under the focused tile's ambient light. A folder is a slideshow, changing whenever the idle screen would have appeared. Empty selects Salon's bundled ambient artwork; a single dash selects the palette's surface colour with a subtle focus glow.

key.name: wallpaper-dim
key.summary: How far the background image is dimmed
key.description: 1.0 hides it entirely. The default leaves enough to feel like a room and not enough to compete with the tiles, which are the thing on screen that has to be read.

key.name: wallpaper-color-treatment
key.summary: How the background image is coloured
key.description: Automatic lets Salon's bundled ambience follow the focused tile while preserving the original colours of custom pictures. Original always preserves the image, focus recolours it from the focused tile, and accent recolours it from the chosen interface accent.

key.name: safe-area-percent
key.description: Percentage inset from screen edges to avoid TV overscan.

key.name: animation-scale
key.description: 0 disables animation entirely.

key.name: reduced-motion
key.description: Force the reduced-motion focus treatment regardless of the system setting.

key.name: browser-command
key.description: Command used to launch URL tiles. Empty means autodetect.

key.name: autostart
key.description: Launch Salon automatically on login.

key.name: last-focused-tile
key.description: Used to restore focus on startup.

key.name: cec-enabled
key.description: Requires cec-client to be installed. Off by default.

key.name: favourite-tile-ids
key.description: Tiles the user pinned from the options menu, in the order they were pinned. Backs the Favourites row, which sits above Recents.

key.name: recent-tile-ids
key.description: Most-recent-first, backs the Recents row.

key.name: idle-inhibit-seconds
key.description: How long Salon inhibits screen blanking after launching something, before handing off to the child app's own inhibit (if any). 0 disables the inhibit entirely.

key.name: tile-scale
key.description: Scales every tile relative to the 342x204du wide-card design size, along with its type, padding, bloom and row heading. The 0.55 design default produces a 188x112du Home card. At the 0.5 floor the title reaches its legibility limit and stops shrinking with the card.

key.name: row-spacing-scale
key.description: Scales the vertical gap between rows. Lower packs more rows on screen.

key.name: volume-step-percent
key.description: How far one press of volume up or down moves the output level.

key.name: audio-sink
key.description: Description of the output to select on startup. Empty follows the system default. Matched by description because node ids are not stable across reboots.

key.name: key-repeat-initial-ms
key.description: How long a direction must be held before it starts repeating.

key.name: key-repeat-interval-ms
key.description: Interval between repeats before acceleration kicks in.

key.name: remote-hint
key.summary: Show the pairing code when nothing is connected
key.description: With no controller plugged in and no phone talking to Salon, a small QR code stands in the bottom-right corner offering to make a phone the remote. It disappears as soon as either turns up. Reaching the full pairing screen needs something to press with, which is exactly what is missing in that state; turning this off removes the only route to a remote that does not already require one.

key.name: gamepad-pointer
key.summary: Gamepad pointer control in browser tiles
key.description: When on, the right stick drives the system cursor over a browser-hosted tile so a controller can operate a site that has no remote-friendly UI. The desktop asks for remote-control permission once; the grant is remembered in remote-desktop-restore-token.

key.name: input-injection
key.summary: How Salon injects pointer and keyboard input
key.description: The phone trackpad, phone typing and gamepad pointer control all need to move the system cursor, which on Wayland only the compositor may do. "auto" asks mutter directly (org.gnome.Mutter.RemoteDesktop) and falls back to the desktop portal if that is not there; mutter grants it without a dialog, which is the only route a television with no keyboard or mouse attached can complete, since the portal's consent dialog can only be dismissed with the pointer it is gating. "portal" always takes the sanctioned route and its one-time consent dialog — correct where the sandbox boundary matters more than unattended setup, and required under Flatpak. "mutter" refuses to fall back, so a misconfigured appliance fails loudly rather than putting an unanswerable dialog on the television.

key.name: remote-desktop-restore-token
key.description: Opaque token from xdg-desktop-portal that lets Salon reopen its remote-control session without asking again. Written by the portal, never by hand. Clearing it makes the permission prompt reappear once, which is how the grant is revoked from Salon's side.

key.name: onboarding-complete
key.description: Set once the user has been through the welcome screens. Clearing it shows them again, which is the supported way to see the introduction a second time.

key.name: show-apps-row
key.summary: Show a row of every installed application
key.description: Off by default: a fresh install has well over a hundred desktop entries, and search already covers starting something that has no tile. On by choice for a machine used as a console.

key.name: input-bindings
key.description: Overrides for the built-in button map, as "source:code" to action name — for example "pad:305" to "ok" on a Nintendo-layout controller, whose south and east buttons are the other way round. An empty action means the button is deliberately silenced. Anything not listed here uses Salon's default for that source.

key.name: screensaver-minutes
key.summary: Minutes of inactivity before the idle screen appears
key.description: After this many idle minutes Salon fades to a slowly drifting clock; any button brings it back. This does not change the desktop's screen-lock preference. 0 turns it off.

key.name: show-games-row
key.summary: Show a row of installed games
key.description: Reads the libraries Steam, Heroic, Lutris and RetroArch keep on disk and puts every installed game in one row, with the cover art those launchers have already downloaded. Off by default: a machine with no games would gain an empty row, and the scan costs a directory walk per Steam library.

key.name: disabled-providers
key.summary: Providers the user has turned off
key.description: Provider ids that are skipped when building the catalogue. Disabling by id rather than by deleting the file means a misbehaving provider can be switched off from the sofa.

key.name: fetch-site-icons
key.summary: Use each site's own icon for its tile
key.description: When a URL tile has no artwork of its own, ask the site it points at for its apple-touch-icon or favicon, once, and cache it. Off means every web tile falls back to the browser's icon, which makes them all look alike. Nothing is asked of any third party either way.

key.name: browser-extra-flags
key.description: Appended to every URL tile's browser command, after the flags Salon computes.
